summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: faster grouped MoE decode and asynchronous weight loading
details: Dynamic MoE decode builds the grouped expert prefix in parallel, and full-capacity DSA indexer grids are bounded.
Ordinary CUDA weights load through a bounded asynchronous io_uring ring, including weights that span several expandable CUDA mappings.
Earlier autotuning decisions are invalidated once, so the first start after updating tunes again.
Sliced KDA state indices and serialized block-FP8 execution reuse prepared kernels within their planned capacity.
Trellis lookup-table codebooks and the EXL3 container use neutral names.
